[[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} '''Nord Sword''' is a [[Deep North]]-tier [[Swords|sword]]. Like other swords it has: *Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets. *Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach. It cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding '''Cast Nord Sword''' and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. ==Mould== '''Mould: Nord Sword''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * From [[Barrel]]s in [[Abandoned Village]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. ==Upgrade information== Like most Deep North-tier weapons, the Nord Sword can be upgraded into: * {{item link|Frostfire Sword}} (with a [[Frostfire Essence]]) * {{item link|Thunderblood Sword}} (with a [[Thunderblood Essence]]). An upgraded Nord Sword will '''NOT''' keep its upgrade level when it is modified using an essense.
